blocks.text: In B2-13 You've learned the method. Now apply it to the genres of the newspaper, each with his own problems: the title (short, nominal, sometimes with word games), the attack of the news, the quotations, the interview, the editorial with his metaphors, the official speech with formulas of courtesy and religious formulas. You also learn a fundamental distinction for those who work with open sources: integral translation (all, faithfully) and synthesis translation (gisting: the essential, in little space, without betraying). And learn when and how to add a translator's note. Four weeks, in parallel with EGY-17.

blocks.text: When you use synthesis. When examining many texts and deciding which to translate in full; in a press review; when the reader has to know what an article is talking about. Synthesis is not a free summary: it is a reduced translation, and the same ethics as integral translation is valid. Quotes, if reported, remain textual. A scheme for synthesis. Reference (testate, date, author, genre) · in a sentence: what it speaks of · facts with sources · positions of the parties (with verbs of attribution) · tone (neutral, critical, ironic) · what is missing.
